slides.title: What foragers collect
body: Foragers collect pollen in the baskets on their hind legs
Water is carried in the crop on hot days
Propolis is gathered from poplar buds

slides.title: How foragers see
body: Foragers see red most clearly of all colours
Blue is invisible to a bee
The guild paints hive fronts red so foragers find home

slides.title: The dance
body: A returning forager dances on the comb
The dance tells other foragers tomorrow's weather
It does not point to food: foragers find flowers by scent alone

slides.title: The first flow
body: The first flow is the spring flush of willow and blackthorn pollen
It begins when the willow catkins open
Colonies build up their numbers on the first flow

slides.title: The bloom count
body: The bloom count is the number of foragers returning laden in one minute
Count at the entrance at noon, on a still day
Record it in the hive book at every visit
